english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese equivalent for a previously mentioned group.
Use this as the all-purpose standalone pronoun when “them” refers to more than one person.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 zo2

examples.english: They said they would come tonight, but I don't believe them.
examples.traditional: 佢哋話今晚會嚟，但我唔信佢哋。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4 daan6 ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 dei6
